cases.refreshed: Our quarterly 4-Day Sales feature a large number of books and media from all genres. The sales begin with a preview evening exclusively for Friends members and end with a Bargain Day. Prices at 4-Day Sales are as follows: Books: $1.50 per inch; CDs: (music and software) 4 for $1.00; Audiobooks, DVDs, VCDs and Blu-ray discs: $1 each; Software and games: $1 each or as marked; Box sets of DVDs, CDs, or VCDs: individually priced based on the number of discs in the set; Specialty items: Individually priced; Bargain Day Sales: $5 per paper grocery bag full of books and media. The sale accepts cash, checks, all major credit cards, Apple Pay, and Google Pay. Contactless payments are available. The members-only preview is Thursday, December 3, from 5:00 PM to 8:00 PM. For Thursday night access to the sale, enter at the rear (east side) of the library. You must have a valid membership card for entry, or purchase a membership at the door. Individual memberships allow 1 person to enter; family memberships allow the entire family to enjoy the book sale. You must be present to hold a place in line – you cannot "save" your spot with boxes or other items. Learn more about memberships. The public sale runs Friday, December 4, from 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM and Saturday, December 5, from 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Bargain Day is Sunday, December 6. The sale is open to the public from 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM. Other ongoing Friends of the Milpitas Library sales include the Book Nook. We have a variety of great books available at great prices every day in the Book Nook behind the accounts desk on the first floor. All books are 50% off every Sunday. Amazon sales: We have a large catalog of books for sale on Amazon, and we try to offer the lowest price for every title that we list. The next time you're shopping for a used book on Amazon, look for our seller name: Friends of the Milpitas Community Library. eBay sales: View our current listings on eBay. For accessibility accommodations (e.g., ASL), please fill out the online form at sccld.org/accessibility 7+ days prior to the event. If you need assistance with the form, speak with a staff member at your local library, call (408) 540-3947, or email us at ask@lib.sccgov.org.
